messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I had an out of body experience that might have been a dream but it was entirely too vivid and real for me to believe that.

output.original_text: I had an out of body experience that might have been a dream but it was entirely too vivid and real for me to believe that.
output.joy: I had this incredible out of body experience that felt so vivid and real, it was like I was truly soaring beyond my limits!
output.sadness: I had an out of body experience that might have been a dream, but it was so vivid and real, yet it feels heartbreaking not to know what it really was.
output.fear: I had an out of body experience that might have been a dream, but it was far too vivid and real, leaving me feeling unnerved and scared.
output.anger: I had an out of body experience that maybe was a dream, but it was annoyingly too vivid and real for me to just dismiss it!
output.surprise: I had this astonishing out of body experience that might have been a dream, yet it was so incredibly vivid and real, I couldn’t believe it!
output.disgust: I had this strange out of body experience that might have been a dream, but it felt too vivid and real, and honestly, it left a weird taste in my mouth.
